transcript.text: Before coding, how would you choose items A (10,60), B (20,100), C (30,120) for a capacity-50 0/1 knapsack? Explain the steps your approach would take.
I sort items by value/weight and greedily include them when they fit. For A, B, C I get A+B = 160.

Your approach of sorting by value/weight is a common greedy strategy, but it can fail for 0/1 knapsack problems. Have you considered the possibility of including C alone or other combinations to maximize the total value without exceeding the capacity?
